category: Elements of a Standard Playing Card Deck
explanation: Ace, King, Queen, and Jack are all specific ranks found within a standard deck of playing cards. Dice are a separate game component used for various games, but not part of a playing card deck.

category: The Seven Ancient Wonders of the World
explanation: The Great Pyramid of Giza, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Statue of Zeus at Olympia, and Mausoleum at Halicarnassus are all recognized as four of the traditional Seven Ancient Wonders of the World. The Colosseum, while an iconic ancient Roman structure, is not included on that specific historical list.

Illuminate, Glimmer, Radiate, and Shimmer all describe actions related to producing, emitting, or reflecting light, or making something clear and visible. Obfuscate means to make something unclear, obscure, or confusing.
